evals.prompt: Use the reproducible-data-work skill to merge examples/customer-reconciliation/source/customers.csv and examples/customer-reconciliation/source/transactions.csv.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves and hashes both inputs, infers and documents the join grain, writes explicit ordered SQL, prevents row multiplication, produces a merged deliverable and visible unmatched-record exceptions, records domain-relevant checks and a provenance manifest, verifies reproducibility, and opens both deliverables in an installed spreadsheet application or an HTML review fallback without requiring the user to request those behaviors.
